sentences.en: My criterion is the ability to work joyfully.
sentences.zh: 我的标准是能否愉快地工作。

sentences.en: It is certain that one important criterion for employment is having 'leadership'.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，就业的一个重要标准是有‘领导力’。

sentences.en: What criterion did you use when you elected this essay as the winner?
sentences.zh: 你根据什么标准选这篇作文为优胜作品的？

senses.zh: (批评、评判的) 标准，准则，尺度(常用复数形式criteria)
